components.name: Solar Cells (Monocrystalline Silicon)
components.reasoning: These are the core functional units that convert sunlight into electricity and are universally the main component in these modules.

components.name: Tempered Glass Cover
components.reasoning: The front protective layer, made of tempered glass, is standard in virtually all modules to protect cells from environmental damage while allowing light penetration.

components.name: Aluminum Frame
components.reasoning: Provides structural support and mounting interface; it is a separate manufactured component procured to frame the module.

components.name: Encapsulation Material (EVA)
components.reasoning: Polymeric sheets like EVA encapsulate and protect the solar cells, a standardized procured subassembly between the glass and backsheet layers.

components.name: Backsheet
components.reasoning: The rear protective layer provides electrical insulation and moisture barrier; it is procured as a distinct component, though some premium modules use alternative designs.

components.name: Junction Box
components.reasoning: An electrical subassembly mounted to the back, housing connections and bypass diodes; critical for safe electrical integration and is a separately manufactured component.

phase1_initial_proposals.technology_reasoning: Monocrystalline silicon photovoltaic modules dominate global solar panel production (~85%) in 2024 due to their superior efficiency (20-22%) and cost-effectiveness, making them the industry standard for both commercial and residential solar installations.

components.name: Solar Cell Assembly (Monocrystalline Silicon Cells)

components.name: Backsheet

components.name: Junction Box

components.name: Encapsulation Film (EVA or POE Sheets)

components.name: Mounting Rails/Structural Mounting Hardware
components.reasoning: Aluminum or steel rails and brackets used to mechanically fix PV panels to mounting racks or rooftops, often procured separately from panel manufacturers as part of installation systems.

components.name: Bypass Diode Assembly
components.reasoning: Electronic subcomponent housed in the junction box or as part of junction box assembly, vital for preventing hot spots under shading conditions; often integrated but sometimes procured separately.

phase1_initial_proposals.technology_specification: Monocrystalline silicon photovoltaic (PV) module used in commercial and residential solar panel installations, consisting of encapsulated solar cells assembled into a framed panel designed for outdoor durability and electrical integration.

components.name: Encapsulation material (EVA sheets)

components.name: Backsheet

components.name: Junction box

components.name: Bypass diodes (within junction box)
